title: UK government adds Missing People charity to guidance for missing persons abroad
excerpt: The UK government updated its guidance on September 30, 2026, to include information about the charity Missing People.
bodyHtml:
The UK government updated its guidance regarding British nationals who go missing abroad on September 30, 2026. The update includes information about the charity Missing People, which is dedicated to helping bring missing people back to their families.

According to the guidance, the charity provides services including a helpline, emotional and practical support, dedicated family support, publicity for eligible cases, peer support, and signposting or referral to specialist organisations. A support worker from the charity can discuss a situation, provide ongoing emotional support, help navigate processes and services, offer advocacy, and connect families with other specialist support services.

The guidance also notes that the Foreign, Commonwealth & Development Office cannot carry out any physical searches for the missing person, fund any searches for the person, or offer rewards for information. The Foreign, Commonwealth & Development Office can be contacted 24/7 from the UK on +44 (0)20 7008 5000.
topic: Getting help if someone goes missing abroad
